cases.purpose: An ENOSPC stdout failure is followed by a normal ss call in the same shell.
cases.oracle: Direct, guarded Linux syscall and /dev/full controls, plus raw independently decoded seccomp notification records where applicable.
cases.comparison: Fixed semantic statuses and markers; raw output, errno controls and bounded notification request/reply bytes are retained for independent review.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-network-controls-r1.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control devfull
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control diag-ok
/usr/bin/ss -tn >"$HOME/native-ss.raw" 2>"$HOME/native-ss.err"
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-network-controls-r1.py
[[ $(type -t ss) == builtin ]] || exit 99
ss -tn >/dev/full 2>"$HOME/full.err"; a=$?
ss -tn >"$HOME/recovered.out" 2>"$HOME/recovered.err"; b=$?
IFS= read -r h <"$HOME/recovered.out" || h=''
if [[ $h == 'Netid'* ]]; then header=yes; else header=no; fi
printf 'full=%s recovered=%s header=%s\n' "$a" "$b" "$header"
printf 'full=%s recovered=%s\n' "$a" "$b" >"$HOME/status.raw"
